title: Colors Around Us
yt_description:
In this song, your little one will learn to identify and associate colors with everyday objects. Pip and friends will take them on a fun adventure to discover the world of colors. This catchy tune is designed to be simple, repetitive, and easy to follow.

🎵 Colors Around Us

Hello
Friends
Let's play

Yellow sun
Blue sky
Green grass

Colors all
Around us
Fun to see

Orange ball
Purple flower
Pink book

Colors all
Around us
Fun to see
Bye friends

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.

#Shorts #KidsSongs #colors #everydayobjects #learning
